source: convention: hands on the hips, one leg steps back and across behind the other, both knees bend until the back knee nears the floor, the pelvis turning a little towards the back leg and the chest kept square, push back to standing; left then right; the hips are held in place horizontally (pin none: with both legs moving on every rep a feet pin would slide the front foot by half the step), so the front foot slides forward under them; angles UNSOURCED
